name: Destructive actions last
rule: Keep destructive actions apart and last in order, and make people confirm them with a clear, specific prompt.

leaders.note: Irreversible actions use a danger modal whose primary button is styled as a danger action. The cancel button comes first and the primary action sits at the end.
Destructive dialogs put focus on Cancel and lead with the consequence. The verb-noun primary button sits last, and high-stakes ones require typing the resource name.
Deleting a file is a dialog use case. Dismiss comes before confirm, with the actions grouped at the end of the dialog.
